newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were bid steady to lower Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, this week, Mississippi (St Paul), bid 175 percent of tariff - unchanged, no offer.
- Two barges, this week, mid-Mississippi, bid 160 percent - unchanged, no offer.
- One barge, next week, mid-Mississippi, bid 170 percent - down five percentage points from similar bid, no offer.
- Four barges, one each week of October, mid-Mississippi, bid 210 percent - down five percentage points, offered 220 - no comparison.
- Four barges, one each week of December, Mississippi (St Louis) , bid 125 percent, offered at 135 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, one each week of April, Mississippi (McGregor and south), bid 140 percent - unchanged, offered 170 - no comparison.
